title: Wso2am: In Apache CXF, the Netty-based HTTP client transport (cxf-rt-transports-http-netty-client) did not verify that…
description: A critical security vulnerability in the wso2am package affects versions prior to 4.7.0-r4. The issue lies in Apache CXF's Netty-based HTTP client transport, which fails to verify that the hostname in the server's TLS certificate matches the host being called. This flaw can lead to severe confidentiality and integrity impacts. A fix is available in version 4.7.0-r4.
